claim_text: The last two unresolved S&S Catering family defendants (case 22-CR-224) have dispositions per Sahan Journal's own trackers: Abdiwahab Ahmed Mohamud pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit money laundering and wire fraud, admitting he worked for S&S Catering and forged documents to help it steal $17 million from the federal government, and agreed with prosecutors to a recommended sentence of 11 to 14 years (no sentencing date found); and Yusuf Bashir Ali pleaded guilty in September 2023 to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and stealing nearly $280,000 -- resolving this corpus's prior open ambiguity about whether he was the same 'Yusuf Ali, 41' described in an earlier Hiiraan Online source as tied to Youth Inventors Lab and S&S Catering (Sahan Journal's full-name usage confirms the identity) -- and was sentenced to 1.5 years in prison on April 15, 2026.

supporting_passages.quote: Yusuf Bashir Ali was sentenced to 1.5 years in prison on April 15, 2026. He pleaded guilty in September 2023 to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and stealing nearly $280,000.

Abdiwahab Mohamud, 35, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit money laundering and wire fraud. He worked for S&S Catering and forged documents to help the company steal $17 million from the federal government.

amounts.methodology: Amount Yusuf Bashir Ali admitted stealing, per Sahan Journal.

qualifiers: No primary court record has been captured for either defendant; both dispositions rest on Sahan Journal's own reporting.

This corpus's prior batch (claim-22cr224-sscatering-plea-dispositions, from an earlier Hiiraan-sourced pass) had left fof-d-030's identity as a possible-but-unconfirmed match to a passing Hiiraan reference; this claim resolves that ambiguity via Sahan Journal's consistent full-name usage but does not retroactively edit the earlier claim record.
Abdiwahab Ahmed Mohamud's 11-14 year figure is a plea-agreement recommendation, not a confirmed sentence; he does not appear in Sahan Journal's sentencing tracker as of this pass.
